arxiv-2302-13738.title: Thermal boundary condition studies in large aspect ratio Rayleigh-Bénard convection
arxiv-2302-13738.creator: Theo Käufer 1 , Philipp P. Vieweg 1 , Jörg Schumacher 1,2 , and Christian Cierpka 1
arxiv-2302-13738.description: Abstract We study the influence of thermal boundary conditions on large aspect ratio Rayleigh-Bénard convection by a joint analysis of experimental and numerical data sets for a Prandl number Pr = 7 \mathrm{Pr}=7 and Rayleigh numbers Ra = 10 5 − 10 6 \mathrm{Ra}=10^{5}-10^{6} .

arxiv-2303-18136.title: Machine-learned Adversarial Attacks against Fault Prediction Systems in Smart Electrical Grids Conference: AdvML ’22: Workshop on Adversarial Learning Methods for Machine Learning and Data Mining; August 15, 2022; Washington DC, USA AdvML ’22: Workshop on Adversarial Learning Methods for Machine Lea
arxiv-2303-18136.creator: Carmelo Ardito, Yashar Deldjoo, Tommaso Di Noia, Eugenio Di Sciascio, Fatemeh Nazary, Giovanni Servedio
arxiv-2303-18136.description: Abstract . In smart electrical grids, fault detection tasks may have a high impact on society due to their economic and critical implications. In the recent years, numerous smart grid applications, such as defect detection and load forecasting, have embraced data-driven methodologies.

arxiv-2308-02002.title: Outflowing helium from a mature mini-Neptune
arxiv-2308-02002.creator: Michael Zhang, Fei Dai, Jacob L. Bean, Heather A. Knutson, Federica Rescigno
arxiv-2308-02002.description: Abstract We announce the detection of escaping helium from TOI 2134b , a mini-Neptune a few Gyr old. The average in-transit absorption spectrum shows a peak of 0.37 ± 0.05 0.37\pm 0.05 % and an equivalent width of W avg = 3.3 ± 0.3 W_{\rm avg}=3.3\pm 0.3 mÅ.

arxiv-2309-05532.title: Probing Spin Wave Diffraction Patterns of Curved Antennas
arxiv-2309-05532.creator: L. Temdie, V. Castel, M.B. Jungfleisch, R. Bernard, H. Majjad, D. Stoeffler, Y. Henry, M. Bailleul, V. Vlaminck
arxiv-2309-05532.description: Abstract We report on the dependence of curvilinear shaped coplanar waveguides on the near-field diffraction patterns of spin waves propagating in perpendicularly magnetized thin films. Implementing the propagating spin waves spectroscopy techniques on either concentrically or eccentrically shaped antennas, we show how the link budget is directly affected by the spin wave interference, in good agreement with near-field diffraction simulations.

arxiv-2404-13450.title: Examining Committee
arxiv-2404-13450.description: Abstract The impact of the Generalized Uncertainty Principle (GUP) on Hawking particle emission in a rotating linear dilaton black hole (RLDBH) spacetime is examined in this thesis. The concerned study presents a thermal emission model for black holes (BHs) that incorporates the influence of gravitational lens particles through GUP during the quantum tunneling process.

arxiv-2502-07427.description: Abstract . A word w w is said to be concise in a class of groups if, for every G G in that class such that the set of w w -values w ​ { G } w\{G\} is finite, the verbal subgroup w ⁡ ( G ) w(G) is also finite.

arxiv-2504-06642.title: Current-Enabled Optical Conductivity of Collective Modes in Unconventional Superconductors
arxiv-2504-06642.creator: Gerrit Niederhoff, Ryusei Kataoka, Kazuaki Takasan, Naoto Tsuji
arxiv-2504-06642.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the current-enabled linear optical conductivity of collective modes in superconductors with unconventional pairing symmetries. After deriving general formulas for the optical conductivity of a superconductor featuring multiple pairing channels and bands using the path integral formalism, we apply these formulas to several models.

arxiv-2504-21560.title: Plausible Indication of Gamma-Ray Absorption by Dark Matter in NGC 1068
arxiv-2504-21560.creator: Gonzalo Herrera
arxiv-2504-21560.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gonzalo Herrera. NGC 1068 is the brightest extragalactic source in high-energy neutrinos as seen by IceCube, yet the accompanying gamma-ray flux is orders of magnitude weaker. It has been argued that this indicates that the bulk of neutrinos and gamma rays are emitted in the innermost vicinity of the central supermassive black hole, which is transparent to neutrinos, but opaque to gamma rays.

arxiv-2511-07812.title: Revisiting MLLM Based Image Quality Assessment: Errors and Remedy
arxiv-2511-07812.creator: Zhenchen Tang, Songlin Yang, Bo Peng, Zichuan Wang, Jing Dong
arxiv-2511-07812.description: Abstract The rapid progress of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) has boosted the task of image quality assessment (IQA). However, a key challenge arises from the inherent mismatch between the discrete token outputs of MLLMs and the continuous nature of quality scores required by IQA tasks. This discrepancy significantly hinders the performance of MLLM-based IQA methods.

arxiv-2512-19463.title: Double Resonance Strategy for Interferometric Detection of Axions
arxiv-2512-19463.creator: Spencer Green 1 , Frank Wilczek 2,3,4,1
arxiv-2512-19463.description: Abstract We propose a double-resonant interferometric strategy for axion dark matter detection that combines microwave circuit resonance with Fabry–Pérot optical enhancement. In a strong magnetic field, axion–photon mixing induces a weak oscillating electric field, which is first amplified by a resonant circuit and then transduced into an optical phase shift via the electro-optic effect.

arxiv-2601-16560.title: Eclipse Attacks on Ethereum’s Peer-to-Peer Network DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: The Web Conference 2026; April 13–17, 2026; Dubai, UAE ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2026/04 Thanks: Accepted by T he ACM Web Conference (WWW) 2026. ⋆ \star denotes corresponding authors.
arxiv-2601-16560.creator: Ruisheng Shi 1,⋆ , Yuxuan Liang 1 , Zijun Guo 1 , Qin Wang 2 , Lina Lan 1,⋆ , Chenfeng Wang 1 , Zhuoyi Zheng 1
arxiv-2601-16560.description: Abstract . Eclipse attacks isolate blockchain nodes by monopolizing their peer-to-peer connections. The attacks were extensively studied in Bitcoin (SP’15, SP’20, CCS’21, SP’23) and Monero (NDSS’25), but their practicality against Ethereum nodes remains underexplored, particularly in the post-Merge settings. We present the first end-to-end implementation of an eclipse attack targeting Ethereum (2.0 version) execution-layer nodes.

arxiv-2602-10301.title: Impact of Separation Distance on the Performance and Annual Energy Production of a Dual-Flap Oscillating Surge Wave Energy Converter
arxiv-2602-10301.creator: Alaa Ahmed
arxiv-2602-10301.description: Abstract Among the different concepts for wave energy conversion, oscillating surge wave energy converters have been shown to have a high capture width ratio. The primary wave capture structure consists of a flap hinged at the seabed or to a floating platform. Different flap configurations, including single and dual-flap, have been investigated.

pmc-10669501.title: The Roles of NRF2-Regulated Oxidative Stress and Mitochondrial Quality Control in Chronic Liver Diseases
pmc-10669501.creator: Jeong-Su Park, Nodir Rustamov, Yoon-Seok Roh, Zhihui Feng
pmc-10669501.description: Chronic liver disease (CLD) affects a significant portion of the global population, leading to a substantial number of deaths each year. Distinct forms like non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and alcoholic fatty liver disease (ALD), though they have different etiologies, highlight shared pathologies rooted in oxidative stress.

pmc-11357911.title: Safety and efficacy of aspirin and indobufen in the treatment of coronary heart disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11357911.creator: Xiaochen Zhang, Qiaoyan Yan, Jiao Jiang, Hua Luo, Yu Ren
pmc-11357911.description: PurposeThis meta-analysis aimed to compare the safety and efficacy of aspirin and indobufen in patients with coronary heart disease. The primary focus was on the incidence of cardiovascular events, bleeding events, and gastrointestinal reactions. Given the relatively limited research on indobufen, this study utilized aspirin as a control drug and employed meta-analysis to integrate existing clinical studies.

pmc-11461951.title: A rare case of extraskeletal Ewing sarcoma
pmc-11461951.creator: Jake Gibbons, Alyssa Mathew-Joseph
pmc-11461951.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Extraskeletal Ewing Sarcoma is a rare tumor of the soft tissues. Primary Ewing Sarcoma of the lung is an exceedingly uncommon variant of Extraskeletal Ewing Sarcoma, with only a small number of cases reported in the literature.

pmc-11468268.title: Implementation lessons learned from the University of California’s Diabetes Prevention Program Initiative
pmc-11468268.creator: Tamra Burns Loeb, Kate Ramm, Maryam Gholami, Kelly Shedd, Samantha Soetenga, Meera Bhagat, Nicholas J Jackson, Un Young Rebecca Chung, O Kenrik Duru, Carol M Mangione, Alison B Hamilton, Tannaz Moin
pmc-11468268.description: BackgroundThe University of California’s Diabetes Prevention Program (UC DPP) Initiative was implemented systemwide to address diabetes and obesity risk on all 10 campuses. As little is known about implementing lifestyle change programs in university settings, we examined implementation partners’ (i.e., UC DPP leaders and campus leads) perceptions of factors influencing program success on UC campuses.

pmc-11686657.title: Open Reduction and Internal Fixation for Posterior Pilon Fracture: Transfibular Approach vs Posterior Approach
pmc-11686657.creator: Hui Zhang, Yaxing Li, Tingjiang Gan
pmc-11686657.description: Category:Trauma; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:For posterior pilon fractures, the posterior approach (PA) is widely used but has its limitations. The transfibular approach (TFA) has been adopted to treat posterior malleolar fractures for the advantage of direct visual confirmation of the reduction status intraoperatively, yet the report of its application on posterior pilon fractures is rare.

pmc-12417320.title: Isolated Stiffness as a Predominant Manifestation of Wilson Disease: A Case Report
pmc-12417320.creator: Ahmed Abdulhussain Shahatta, Ali Azeez Shlaka, Sajjad Ghanim Al‐Badri, Ali Saad Al‐Shammari, Khadija Naeem, Ali Saif Ali, Hussein Rizgar, Nabeel Al‐Fatlawi, Muna Alogaili, Sabry Babiker H Sayed
pmc-12417320.description: Early recognition of atypical Wilson disease (WD) presentations, such as isolated stiffness, is essential to avoid misdiagnosis and facilitate timely intervention. A comprehensive evaluation, including advanced imaging and biochemical analysis, can help differentiate WD in cases where common neurological symptoms are absent, thus preventing progression to severe neurological impairment.

pmc-12452338.title: Empowering Pharmacists in Heartburn Management: Practical Insights for OTC Treatment and Self-Care
pmc-12452338.creator: Mary Barna Bridgeman, Ashok Hospattankar, Kamran Siddiqui, Nardine Nakhla
pmc-12452338.description: Heartburn is a prevalent and frequently self-managed condition, with a myriad of over-the-counter (OTC) treatment options available for self-care. The potential for misinterpretation of drug labels and improper OTC medication selection may result in inadequate treatment, potential drug interactions, as well as medication overuse, misuse, or delay in seeking treatment for a more serious health condition.

pmc-12665424.title: Novel Peptide Therapeutics Targeting the L-Type Calcium Channel Prevent Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy by Decreasing Mitochondrial Energetics
pmc-12665424.creator: Teagan S Er, Daniel Reinke, Alice J Francis, Tanya M Solomon, Helena M Viola, Henrietta Cserne Szappanos, Caitlyn M Richworth, Catherine Jenkins, Juan E Camacho Londoño, Padmapriya Ponnuswamy, Ciaran McFarlane, Filip Van Petegem, Livia C Hool
pmc-12665424.description: Visual AbstractKey Words: αMHC403/+, cardiac, cTnI-G203S, mitochondria, prevention Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is an inherited autosomal dominant disease that affects approximately 1:500 of the general population. HCM arises because of genetic sequence variants in sarcomere proteins or proteins that regulate cardiac contractile function.

pmc-12686416.title: RPS24 microexon isoform as a novel biomarker for estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer progression and therapeutic resistance
pmc-12686416.creator: Jiyeon Park, Dahye Nam, Seung-Hyun Jung, Bin Tian, Yeun-Jun Chung
pmc-12686416.description: Alternative splicing significantly contributes to gene expression heterogeneity and disease progression, yet analyzing its dynamics in short genetic regions such as microexons remains challenging. Here we identified notable variations in ribosomal protein S24 (RPS24) splicing patterns across breast cancer subtypes and investigated this novel regulatory mechanism.

pmc-12885859.title: Comparison of the IDEXX ProCyte One to the ProCyte Dx and ADVIA 120 in Dogs and Cats
pmc-12885859.creator: Richard J Dulli, Kim Yore, Jeremy Hammond, Dennis B DeNicola, Mary B Nabity
pmc-12885859.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe ProCyte One is a veterinary hematology analyzer. It uses laser flow cytometry with four optical detectors to categorize RBCs, WBCs, and platelets.ObjectiveWe aimed to compare results from the ProCyte One with the ProCyte Dx and ADVIA 120, as well as the results of manual PCVs and WBC differential counts, to determine their performance for automated CBCs in dogs and cats.Materials and MethodsProCyte One inter‐assay and intra‐assay precision were assessed using control material and patient samples.

pmc-13066848.title: Progress in machine learning-assisted medical imaging for osteoarthritis and osteoporosis diagnosis: a narrative review
pmc-13066848.creator: Wuyi Ming, Ting Liu, Rui Hu, Wenbin He, Yuan Yang
pmc-13066848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and ObjectiveOsteoarthritis (OA) and osteoporosis (OP) are prevalent musculoskeletal disorders with substantial global health and economic burdens. Imaging is central to their diagnosis and monitoring, yet manual interpretation is vulnerable to inter-reader variability and workload-related fatigue. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), provides data-driven approaches to enhance the accuracy, efficiency, and objectivity of image interpretation.

pmc-13154547.title: Multi-omics analysis of soy isoflavone-induced responses in rumen fermentation, endocrine status and milk production in cows with varying milk yields
pmc-13154547.creator: Xingwei Jiang, Chenguang Zhang, Yuhao Zhang, Jing Li, Jianrong Ren, Jiarui Wang, Xinfeng Hou, Zhihong Zhang, Shengru Wu, Junhu Yao
pmc-13154547.description: BackgroundImproving milk yield and feed efficiency is pivotal for climate-smart dairy systems, as rumen mediated fermentation governs energy and nitrogen utilization and thereby greenhouse-gas emission intensity. Soybean isoflavones (SIF) may modulate rumen fermentation, yet their effects on rumen function, microbiome features, host endocrine/metabolic responses, and lactation performance-particularly across cows with divergent milk-yield phenotypes-remain unclear.

pmc-13216250.title: Metal-organic frameworks with linear and branched polyol backbones for dye removal
pmc-13216250.creator: Safoora Gazvineh, Mohsen Adeli, Mohammad Nemati
pmc-13216250.description: In this study, novel metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) were synthesized using functionalized polyols as organic ligands. Polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) and hyperbranched polyglycerol (hPG) were first mesylated and subsequently modified with 5-aminoisophthalic acid, followed by coordination with iron (III) chloride hexahydrate to form PVA-MOF and hPG-MOF structures.

pmc-13391289.title: Effect of ischemic preconditioning on the expression of Cx43 protein in intestinal ischemia-reperfusion injury in SD rats
pmc-13391289.creator: Ning Liu, Yibo Ma, Zhenzhong Han, Qian Zhang, Jianfeng Cao
pmc-13391289.description: BackgroundIntestinal ischemia reperfusion(I/R) injury is a life-threatening clinical condition. Ischemic preconditioning(IP) can alleviate I/R injury, but its intestinal protective mechanism is still unclear. Connexin 43 (Cx43) is involved in the pathological process of intestinal I/R. This study investigated the correlation between IP protection and Cx43 expression.

pmc-13406341.title: MRPL23 Overexpression Predicts Poor Survival and Is Associated with Mitochondrial Respiratory Signatures in Glioblastoma
pmc-13406341.creator: Justyna Durślewicz, Marek Zdrenka, Łukasz Szylberg, Jędrzej Borowczak
pmc-13406341.description: Simple SummaryGlioblastoma is the most aggressive brain cancer in adults and remains difficult to treat despite advances in surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. Identifying biomarkers associated with patient survival may improve prognostic assessment and support the development of new treatment strategies. In this study, we investigated the mitochondrial ribosomal protein MRPL23 in glioblastoma tissues and public genomic datasets.

pmc-13474937.creator: Swarnshikha Sinha, Danilo Kühn, Fredrik O. L. Johansson, Andreas Lindblad, Pavel A. Korzhavyi, Nils Mårtensson, Alexander Föhlisch

pmc-13594204.title: Correction: Extracellular vesicle-based drug overview: research landscape, quality control and nonclinical evaluation strategies
pmc-13594204.creator: Gangling Xu, Jing Jin, Zhihao Fu, Guangming Wang, Xinhua Lei, Jun Xu, Junzhi Wang

pmc-13622349.title: Stepwise-coordinated polymeric nanoplatform enables traceless cytosolic protein delivery and autophagy blockade for enhanced tumor therapy
pmc-13622349.creator: Peng Zhang, Yaowei Zhu, Hongyu Zhang, Shuai Tang, Zhihui Guo, Xuan Yi, Chunsheng Xiao, Xuesi Chen
pmc-13622349.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Autophagic degradation of proteins following cellular internalization and endosomal escape presents a significant, yet underexplored, challenge in intracellular protein delivery. This highlights the need for delivery carriers capable of concurrently achieving cytosolic delivery and autophagy inhibition. Here, we report a stepwise-coordinated polymeric nanoplatform based on a tailor-made amphiphilic triblock copolymer (mPEG-b-PGBA-b-PGCQ) that enables traceless cytosolic delivery of functional proteins while concurrently suppressing autophagy.
